rfm_tuples.M_value: Mode A confirmed: 10-K and Q1 2026 10-Q both disclose '30% of the Company's cash and cash equivalents held in Russia'. Russia generated $30M of 2025 interest income — i.e., a meaningful chunk of the implied risk-free yield in earnings comes from a jurisdiction that explicitly cannot repatriate. Russia is 5% sales / 7% assets / 30% cash — wildly disproportionate. Mode B Note: 10-K explicitly admits 'sanctions and related banking restrictions have limited, and may continue to limit, the Company's ability to process payments or repatriate profits from Russia'. The $485.3M of US cash + $370.8M ex-US/ex-Russia is the actual usable balance; reported liquidity is overstated by ~30%.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Disclosure is honest but the magnitude is material and underappreciated by headline liquidity metrics. Effective cash for capital allocation purposes is closer to $600M than $856M. This is also a tail-risk event with binary outcome (Russian asset seizure law has been activated against Western firms repeatedly 2022-2025). On a -26.7% drawdown, this remains a non-trivial overhang. Note this is Mode-A PASS (claim is true and disclosed) and Mode-B SEVERE (the implied 'we have $856M of liquidity' is materially misleading without the Russia haircut).

summary: MHK at -26.7% drawdown shows the OPPOSITE forensic-insider tape from ABG: ZERO open-market code-P purchases across 24 months and 99 Form 4 filings, while insiders sold $16.5M ($8.6M in last 12mo). The defining Mode-B negative is the Lorberbaum family LP ('HELEN SUZANNE L', signed Suzanne Helen, confirmed family-group filer per footnotes) liquidating $9.2M across 50 discretionary (non-10b5-1) transactions, accelerating INTO the drawdown — $3.1M sold in the 6 months pre-cutoff at progressively lower prices ($128 down to $96). CEO Lorberbaum (10pct holder per Form 4) sold $4.2M; CFO Brunk sold $524K just 3 days after the 10-K was filed. All sales flagged aff10b5One=0 (discretionary, not pre-planned). Meanwhile the company spent $105M on buybacks at ~$120, while insiders distributed at the same prices — capital is moving from corporate cash to insider pockets. Russia exposure is severe (30% of $856M cash trapped, asset-seizure risk explicitly disclosed). FY2025 operating income -29% YoY ($693M->$490M) despite $365M of cumulative restructuring savings — the cost-out narrative is overstated. Q1 2026 EPS +65% is ~70% driven by tax benefit, not operations. Flooring ROW segment running interim for 4+ months after Wim Messiaen's pre-Q4 resignation. PFAS/silica overhang unquantified. Disclosure quality is generally honest (Russia, segment data, Q1 bridge are all transparent), but the implied 'management believes the stock is undervalued' narrative is directly contradicted by the personal-money tape. Verdict: SHORT-tier. Severity: 1 PASS / 0 UNVERIFIABLE / 5 MODERATE / 2 SEVERE / 1 RED_FLAG. The zero-purchase, family-LP-selling pattern is the cleanest SHORT-bias setup the framework can produce — the inverse of ABG. Caveat: business is not distressed (1.5x leverage, $616M FCF, refinanced revolver pre-cutoff, no going concern, clean audit), so this is a 'reaccelerate-skeptic' SHORT, not a 'distress' SHORT.
